summary: Ballard Power Systems filed a Form 6-K containing a news release announcing a conference call for Q2 2026 results. The call is scheduled for July 31, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. PT. The filing does not announce any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change. It is a routine earnings call notice, which is an ordinary current report and does not constitute a special situation under the defined categories.
